evidence.note: Credential is read via Extension.CurrentCredential(); UsernamePassword maps to UID/PWD and Windows maps to Trusted_Connection=Yes.
Data source kind declares Authentication = [Windows = [], UsernamePassword = []].
Odbc.DataSource(...) is the only data access path, reached from every entry function.
SqlCapabilities overrides (SupportsNumericLiterals, PrepareStatements, FractionalSecondsScale, Sql92Translation).
SQLGetInfo overrides for SQL_SQL92_PREDICATES and SQL_AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS.
ServerAddr (host[:port]) is the connection target; Database names the database.
Optional options record is read for the UseSSL field.
Optional UseSSL logical is passed as its own parameter, which fits no other id.
Optional Query text is passed as its own parameter, which fits no other id.

options-fields.text: The options record is read only for UseSSL. When the record has a UseSSL field that is not null, its value sets the SSL flag. Otherwise SSL falls back to the credential's EncryptConnection setting, defaulting to true.

evidence.note: Reads options[UseSSL] when Record.HasFields(options, "UseSSL") and the value is not null.
Declares UseSSL as the optional logical field of the connector's options.
Results are tables returned by the ODBC driver through Odbc.DataSource; no JSON, CSV, or other parser is present.
The SQLColumns handler only rewrites driver metadata (TYPE_NAME, sizes) and keeps the source type via Value.ReplaceType; it assigns no M types to data columns.
Transport is odbc only, so the web-contents and odata-feed applies_when does not match.
Documentation.Name and LongDescription on the function, plus FieldCaption, FieldDescription and SampleValues on parameters.
UseSSL has Documentation.AllowedValues = {true, false}.
Query parameter has FieldCaption, SampleValues and FieldDescription.
Odbc.DataSource with HierarchicalNavigation = true builds the navigator from the driver catalog at runtime (schema folders, then tables), and the function returns the chosen database's Data.
TestConnection returns the shared SingleStoreODBC.Database entry function call, so the gateway evaluates a normal query.
Folding is shaped by SqlCapabilities and SQLGetInfo overrides.
AstVisitor LimitClause rewrites LIMIT/OFFSET, which is an ODBC-side folding override.
Value.NativeQuery(DataSource, Query, null, [EnableFolding = true]) runs the native query.

native-query-enabled.text: Native query support is enabled by calling Value.NativeQuery with EnableFolding = true in SingleStoreConnectorImplCustomSQL, exposed through the shared SingleStoreODBC.Query function. The Publish record also sets NativeQueryProperties DefaultOptions EnableFolding = true.

evidence.note: Value.NativeQuery call with EnableFolding = true.
Shared function that exposes the custom SQL path.
NativeQueryProperties DefaultOptions set EnableFolding = true.
Loads Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm via Extension.Contents and Expression.Evaluate.
Diagnostics.pqm and OdbcConstants.pqm are loaded through LoadFunction.
Extension.LoadString is used for localized strings, for example DriverName and the labels in the meta records.
Icon16 and Icon32 are loaded from PNG files via Extension.Contents.
Trace switch defaults to false.
LogValue is a no-op unless EnableTraceOutput is true.
SQLGetTypeInfo's Diagnostics.LogValue calls run only when EnableTraceOutput = true.
SQLColumns's Diagnostics.LogValue calls sit behind if (EnableTraceOutput <> true) then Transform else.
